### [1] [A model for optimization of bremsstrahlung γ-quanta generated by high-current relativistic electron beams](https://doi.org/10.1088/1361-6587/ae652e) [正式]
- **期刊**: Plasma Physics and Controlled Fusion
- **作者**: M E Veysman, I R Umarov...N E Andreev
- **发布日期**: 2026-05-01
- **判断**: OpenClaw: 论文核心是激光加速电子（PHELIX, XCELS激光器）产生轫致辐射γ射线源的优化，明确属于激光驱动辐射源 → 类别1
- **置信度**: high
- **依据**: laser-accelerated electrons, bremsstrahlung, gamma-quanta, PHELIX, XCELS

This paper presents a theoretical and numerical optimization of gamma-quanta sources generated by bremsstrahlung from laser-accelerated electrons in near-critical density plasma.
